description: exitMsg placeholder rule: first nullary Msg constructor (Task keeps .go, Bank/Lock get .tick), else first constructor applied to defaults p/r/0/false/[]/none/first enum alt. Bank and Lock gain no crash clause: every cast/call tag (deposit, withdraw, balance; acquire, release) has a clause whose Lean pattern is total (withdraw via the guarded clause with total parts; release via the trailing (release, _), s clause). The global catch-all remains because no module has a bare cast/call clause.
